column1: Transcript: Day Seven of the November Trials. Patient J. We lessened the dosage of the gas. He lived longer this time, but screamed for his mother. It is likely he was hallucinating — seeing his mother jump from a rooftop. He died shortly after, but if we could capture that fear, bottle it, we have something.

The Guild began in Avalon's criminal underworld amid crime factions and power struggles, until Sevati Dumas changed everything. In the 90's, she helped the Guild take out the competition and seize control of Avalon. The Guild played by her rules now, and she aimed to use them to do some real good in the world. I hope to honor and continue Sev's legacy.
